Two high-confidence findings in drivers/media/usb/cx231xx/cx231xx-417.c, both consuming controller-completed urb->actual_length with no bound: (1) cx231xx_bulk_copy lines 1341-1361 — 'buffer_size = urb->actual_length;' (u32) with no minimum check, then kmalloc(buffer_size) followed by 'memcpy(buffer+3, p_buffer, buffer_size-3);' which wraps to ~0xFFFFFFFF on a 0-2 byte short completion from the device: 4GB copy into a 0-2 byte heap object (heap overflow + massive OOB read), plus the ps_head update reading p_buffer+buffer_size-3; the URB buffer is sized sb_size=max_packets*max_pkt_size in cx231xx-core.c:1176 and actual_length is never cross-checked against it. (2) cx231xx_isoc_copy lines 1315-1336 — iso_frame_desc[i].actual_length passes only a >0 test with no max_pkt_size clamp (the sibling cx231xx-video.c:291-303 enforces both 'actual_length <= 0' and '> max_pkt_size' — asymmetric validation), and buffer_copy (lines 1237-1292) can memcpy len-tail_data bytes into the fixed 4096-byte kzalloc p_left_data (cx231xx-core.c:997) unbounded. Safe classifications with evidence: opticon.c:76 (guard 'if (urb->actual_length <= 2) return' executes before any use of data_len), kl5kusb105.c:379-387 (early return on actual_length <= KLSI_HDR_LEN plus explicit clamp), greybus es2.c:844 (actual_length bounded by the fixed kmalloc(ES2_GBUF_MSG_SIZE_MAX)=2048 URB buffer; gb_connection_recv clamps msg_size and gb_operation_message_alloc enforces hd->buffer_size_max), es58x_core.c:1324 (copy_to_cmd_buf EMSGSIZE check + min_t clamp + check_rx_urb EOVERFLOW). Unresolved: cx231xx-dvb.c:257 unchecked actual_length into dvb_dmx_swfilter (dvb-core clamping unread), cx231xx-audio.c:209 length*stride copy into runtime->dma_area, and the usbip seed path (usbip_common.c:387, present and unpatched, excluded by rule as parse-time wire count covered by sibling intents i044/i045). Coverage gaps: non-cx231xx actual_length consumers (307 files tree-wide) triaged by pattern only; HCD-side setters of actual_length not per-site audited. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i064.json.
